courses.synopsis: Energy and society. Sources of energy. Energy demand, supply and forecasting. Conventional and unconventional (renewable) energy. Energy conversion systems and devices for oil, gas, coal, heat, wood, solar, wind, biomass, tidal geothermal, etc. Renewable energy from the global environment perspectives; global warming potential of fossil fuels. New energy sources such as hydrogen. Energy conservation.
